mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of FEDFUNDS declining periods over 5 years, or FEDFUNDS rises in >30% of 20d windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflationary spike (CPIAUCSL crossing above 105) triggers investor risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 105, or >60% of such events fail to correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase over the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST increase, or Rank IC <0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) during a late-cycle expansion indicates labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, UNRATE below 4.5% does not correlate with positive 20d returns (p>0.05), or regime misclassification (IC <0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in labor participation (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS not on upward trend for >60% of the period, or 20d returns not positive when PAYEMS trends up.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) during an expanding labor market triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.5% in expanding labor markets, or <40% correlation.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals balanced economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase over the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase, or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals higher inflation expectations, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS rising does not correlate with negative 20d returns (p>0.05), or regime misclassification (IC <0.1).
